name: tmux-radar
description: Shows a toast in this Claude Code session when an agent in another tmux pane needs you or finishes.

levels.title: Levels to toast
levels.description: Comma-separated mark levels that raise a toast: action (needs you), done (finished), notice (anything else).

radarDir.title: tmux-radar checkout
radarDir.description: Path of the tmux-radar checkout whose scripts answer the toast feed. Leave unset to use the checkout this plugin was loaded from, then the TPM install.
